description: This file defines the configuration class for an OpenID authentication plugin in the OrangeHRM system. It implements plugin configuration initialization by registering a social media authentication service into the dependency container.

classes.name: OpenidAuthenticationPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Configure and initialize the OpenID authentication plugin for OrangeHRM, registering necessary services into the application's dependency container.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin by registering the SocialMediaAuthenticationService with the container.
